full_name: Patricia Persaud | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2020–2021 Physical Sciences Edward, Frances, and Shirley B. Daniels Fellow Louisiana State University
bio: Patricia Persaud is an assistant professor of geophysics at Louisiana State University. Her research focuses on building the next generation of earth models for earthquake-hazard purposes, comprised of high-resolution smaller-scale models from explosions embedded in larger-scale models that are improved through 3D full-waveform inversion.
